== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Alden Zaius is an experienced Overlord characterized by rough, scarred skin that suggests recent injuries. He possesses decades of combat or magical experience and demonstrates the ability to hover in midair. During an encounter with a woman wielding [[Netherclaw]], he displays a defensive and wary attitude, specifically referencing the protection provided by the [[Sage]]. He appears to believe that his actions or communications regarding her will not result in punishment from the [[Sage]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Alden Zaius possesses skin that is rough and marked by scars. His head is covered in hair-like red spikes that form a [[Goldsign]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|This Overlord utilizes [[soulfire]] in combat. He also commands a [[Blood Shadow]].}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Alden Zaius is an Overlord characterized by his rough and scarred skin. He possesses a unique [[Goldsign]] composed of red spikes that drape over his head like hair. Additionally, he commands [[soulfire]] and maintains a [[Blood Shadow]].}}
